name: Nepheg
title: Son of David born in Jerusalem
summary: Nepheg is mentioned in the Bible as one of David's sons born in Jerusalem. He is among several sons that David had after moving to Jerusalem and establishing his royal residence there. Nepheg plays no prominent role in the biblical narrative beyond being listed in the genealogies.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in David's genealogy in 2 Samuel
keyEvents.description: Nepheg is listed among the sons of David who were born in Jerusalem, showing that he was part of the royal family.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in David's genealogy in 1 Chronicles
keyEvents.description: In the parallel genealogy in 1 Chronicles, Nepheg is again mentioned as one of David's sons born in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: David's sons mentioned in 1 Chronicles 14
keyEvents.description: Nepheg is again listed among David's sons in another list of children born in Jerusalem after David became king over all Israel.

keyEvents.title: Another Nepheg in Exodus
keyEvents.description: A person named Nepheg is also mentioned as the son of Izhar and thus a Levite, in the genealogy of Moses and Aaron. This is a different person from David's son.
